detailed_descriptions.en: Explore the Void with these additional in-game items: In-Game Item - Unique Rogue Trader Throne Change the appearance of the throne on your voidship’s bridge to something even more illustrious and befitting of your status as Rogue Trader. In-Game Item - Cherub Pet Allows you to change the appearance of your trusty companion from the regular Servoskull to the Cherub!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Explore the Void with these additional in-game items:

  • In-Game Item - Unique Rogue Trader Throne Change the appearance of the throne on your voidship’s bridge to something even more illustrious and befitting of your status as Rogue Trader. 

  • In-Game Item - Cherub Pet
    Allows you to change the appearance of your trusty companion from the regular Servoskull to the Cherub!
